# ReservoirComputing

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A recurrent neural network framework where only the readout layer is trained, while the reservoir's internal dynamics remain fixed. Enables low-cost, hardware-friendly neuromorphic implementations in iNEST, leveraging nonlinear dynamics without complex training.
